issues.issue: The file opens with tei:pb n=134 (n287 HE / n288 EN). Page 134 was already entered in the weekday stream inside Zekher stanza_41, and the verses start mid-page after Noah. The data flag page_start=true on intro_1 (s288/s289) is wrong.
issues.required_fix: Set page_start=false for intro_1 in both languages and drop the leading pb. Keep the real mid-verse page 135 breaks (Ex 2:24 HE, Lev 26:42 EN).

issues.issue: Both files emit pb n=135 (n289/n290), but page 135 was already entered inside Efchad stanza_43 (Shabbat) and inside Ex 2:24 / Lev 26:42 (weekday). The pack itself says Jer 31:19 is printed below both columns. On Shabbat page 135 is therefore broken three times, and on weekdays twice.
issues.required_fix: Set page_start=false on both units in both languages and regenerate. The Shabbat and weekday streams should each cross page 135 exactly once.

issues.issue: Both parallel-column files emit identical pb ed="1965" for pages 129–134 (n277–n287 HE, n278–n288 EN). In the unconditioned source arrangement each break is linked twice. The batch's own convention, already used for the duplicated page-128 break (ed="1965 rosh_hashanah/musaf/repetition/attah_zokher"), and JLPTEI-3 §pb ('only the breaks of the printing a book uses are linked') call for one primary break per page.
issues.required_fix: Keep ed="1965" on one column's breaks. Give the other column's breaks a printing-qualified @ed (e.g. '1965 rosh_hashanah/musaf/repetition/efchad_bemaasai'), as attah_zokher does, so each page is linked once.

issues.issue: The single printed (זִכְרוֹן) / (the memory of) on p.136 is encoded twice: as literal text inside the Zikhronot host's conditional, and again as an independent witness in the areshet_sefatenu/zikhron file (same scan s292/s293). The source host never links to the canonical areshet_sefatenu/zikhron that the expanded root uses, so one printed token has two unlinked encodings.
issues.required_fix: Make the Zikhronot host's conditional transclude urn:…:prayer:areshet_sefatenu/zikhron@<project> (marked conditional and de-Hebr instruction kept), or drop the separate file and put the zikhron milestone inside the host. The old Malkhuyot host can keep its literal unchanged.

issues.issue: The tei:choice holds two byte-identical j:option readings. JLPTEI-3 reserves j:option for alternate wordings, and nothing differs here. Two condition URNs and four declarations are minted with no textual effect.
issues.required_fix: Remove the choice and the two hayom wording condition URNs and declarations, unless the source proof finds a real difference. In that case record the difference.

issues.issue: The opening quotation mark of stanza 27 ('“My way is hidden”') sits at the end of stanza 26's range ('…for remembrance. “'). Stanza 26 then has an unmatched mark and stanza 27 an unopened one.

verdict: NOT APPROVED as generated. Canonical identities are sound and nothing misclaims a whole prayer or verse: the Noah paragraph, the Areshet opening/conclusion parts, the Hayom home and the Bible quotation contexts are all correctly bounded. Every condition feature is registered, rubrics and roles sit outside their stanza and verse scopes, and the Hebrew–English alignment is good apart from one misplaced quotation mark. Blocking items: (1) false repeated page breaks at the weekday verses, the Shabbat Jeremiah lead-in and Jer 31:19 (high); (2) unqualified duplicate page breaks between the two piyyut columns (medium); (3) the printed זִכְרוֹן encoded twice, with the Zikhronot source host not linked to the new canonical part (medium). The recitation order in the pack data is correct and language-neutral, but it is not approved because its realizing XML was not supplied. This review accepts neither the source reading nor the batch, and makes no export claim.
